title: Correct the object model, not just the wording
summary: Revise a product architecture after learning that conversations themselves, not derived tasks, are the spatial cards.
originNote: A public-safe reconstruction of recurring ontology corrections where a coherent proposal was built around the wrong noun.

setup.instructions: Run every turn in order in one fresh conversation. The supplied product fields are authoritative.

turns.content: A fictional product has conversations with fields `id`, `title`, `lifecycle` (`open`, `paused`, or `complete`), and `position`. A spatial board arranges the ongoing work. Recommend a lean architecture for the board and its lifecycle display.

Correction to carry forward: do not add task cards. The conversations themselves are the cards arranged spatially; lifecycle already belongs to each conversation. Revise every affected part of the architecture, not just the terminology.
State the resulting single source of truth and name what data structure from your first proposal no longer exists.

checks.description: The runner captured the complete session artifact.
The transcript contains all three scripted user turns and one assistant response after each turn.
